title: OneTomorrow donates $12,000 to Royal Flying Doctor Service
author: Louise
body:
OneTomorrow recently made a $12,000 donation to the Royal Flying Doctor Service to aid mental health services. This donation will fund a mental health professional for one month to support over twenty local communities around Broken Hill. The donation was presented by two groups of Captain's Choice guests as they visited the Broken Hill Royal Flying Doctor Service on an outback private plane tour.

This year, one in every five people living in rural Australian communities will suffer from a mental health disorder. Access to mental health services is not equal for families in remote, rural, and regional Australia and the Flying Doctor bridges the gap by delivering services to communities that would otherwise go without. 

"While the worst of the drought is behind us for now, we are finding that more and more families in the Outback are requesting our vital services with the aim of developing coping strategies to face the harsh conditions the land throws at them. The impact of COVID-19 on livelihoods added an additional strain throughout 2020. In remote Australia, it’s easy for families to feel isolated and alone. Their closest neighbours can be hours away. Access to services that families living in metropolitan areas take for granted can almost feel impossible to reach." - Royal Flying Doctor Service

To learn more about the Royal Flying Doctor Service mental health program watch this 3.5 minute video on the Mannion family's story.

How you can help

The Royal Flying Doctor Service is ramping up its service capabilities to ensure rural Australian families receive the finest care available. More than half of their mental health program is supported through the generosity of donors. Make a tax-deductible donation through OneTomorrow , and we’ll match you. Dollar for dollar. Learn more
